**tuna-fonts 0.3.0**: two new languages from the community, and the first round of things you asked for on Reddit. If you have 0.2.x, the app will offer it when you open it.

### New languages
- **Simplified Chinese**, by [@Hokkaidotosuto](https://github.com/Hokkaidotosuto), with type tuned for hanzi. Thank you!
- **Brazilian Portuguese**, by [@renatosouzadesign](https://github.com/renatosouzadesign). Obrigado!

The app starts in your Windows language, or pick one in Settings. Want it in yours? [Open an issue](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/issues/new/choose) and you'll get a simple sheet with all the texts, no coding needed.

### New
- **Uninstall fonts** from the selection bar. Fonts installed for your user go to the recycle bin, so you can get them back. System fonts, fonts for all users and watched folders are left alone.
- **Watched folders can start deactivated.** New option in Settings: add a folder with 3,000 fonts without flooding every app's font menu, then turn on only the ones you need.

- **See Google Fonts big before installing.** In Discover, double-click a font to open a large preview with every style, your own text and a size slider.

### Improved
- **Shift+click** selects every font between the last one you picked and this one, so deactivating hundreds at once is quick.
- **Deactivated fonts are easier to read.** They still look switched off, but you can actually inspect them now.
- **Each family shows how many styles it has**, next to its name.
- **A tidier type scale** across the interface (also by @Hokkaidotosuto).

### Downloads
- **`tuna-fonts_0.3.0_x64-setup.exe`**: installer (per user, no admin rights needed). Updates itself.
- **`tuna-fonts_0.3.0_x64-portable.zip`**: portable version; unzip and run `tuna-fonts.exe`.

Windows 10/11, 64-bit. **Not code-signed**, so Windows SmartScreen may warn you the first time: *More info → Run anyway*.

Found a bug? [Open an issue](https://github.com/atunfrito/tuna-fonts/issues/new/choose).

---

**En español:** la 0.3.0 trae dos idiomas nuevos hechos por la comunidad, chino simplificado (gracias, @Hokkaidotosuto) y portugués de Brasil (gracias, @renatosouzadesign). Ya se pueden desinstalar fuentes desde la barra de selección (las de tu usuario van a la papelera), hay una opción para que las carpetas vigiladas empiecen desactivadas y, en Descubrir, doble clic en una fuente la enseña en grande con todos sus estilos. Además, Mayús+clic selecciona todas las fuentes entre la última que marcaste y esta, las fuentes desactivadas se leen mejor, cada familia dice cuántos estilos tiene y la interfaz tiene una escala tipográfica más ordenada.
